description: I'm Dens Akoka from Dundee, Scotland, joining Space Apps London. I make Pale Dot (paledot.org), a 3D journey from Earth to the edge of the universe, with planet sizes and distances at true scale. For this challenge I'll add guided tours of the machines NASA left behind: Apollo sites and rovers, Viking 1, Opportunity and Ingenuity on Mars, and Voyager 1 and 2 in interstellar space. Real NASA photos, landing sites pinned in 3D, and each machine's real flight path from NASA/JPL data.
